items.title: Binance users in some European countries told to pull crypto before fees kick in, with accounts closing by year end
items.summary: Affected accounts are reportedly set to close on Dec. 31. Users in Spain, France, and Poland say they've received similar notices.

items.title: U.S. Treasury moves to cut off crypto exchange MEXC over $16 billion in alleged illicit flows
items.summary: Treasury billed the move as part of its campaign against Iran, but the order rests on MEXC's alleged role in Russian illicit finance.

items.title: Gnosis Pay breach exposes card numbers, home addresses and linked crypto wallets
items.summary: One user said the exposed data tied his home address and card number to every crypto wallet linked to his account, raising the risk of targeted scams.

Apple, Meta reject OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans, leaving crypto firms as the ones to watch
items.summary: Strategy, Coinbase, Circle and Robinhood are among six companies from the venture’s initial selection with no disclosed objection, after 90% of issuers opted out.

items.title: U.S. prediction markets regulator issues demand that clashes directly with courts
items.summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission said regulated exchanges can't cut off customers state-by-state, but firms like Kalshi are under court orders to do so.
